verified_license_notes.conclusion: Commercial and noncommercial reuse permitted with explicit source and dataset type and date/state attribution. Original record DATUM_SYS and the OPSI metadata update are not proven to be dataset snapshot dates.

GeoNames states its geographical database is reusable under a Creative Commons attribution license. The 2 source entries are generic search pages rather than unique feature IDs; geographic identity has not been independently vetted.

Mapcarta credits open data from OSM and other sources; its reuse instructions concern map images and underlying OSM/map tiles. No blanket coordinate-copy right asserted for STK. Confirm original source/ODbL attribution or replace with GURS.

constraints: No event start or map marker is approved: every GURS record is REVIEW/approved_for_runtime=false.
Only unit tests temporarily clone the 20 GURS records with explicit approval; those ephemeral copies are NEVER committed as an index or exposed to the browser.
A 0-match result for Kranj at 10 km is NOT evidence that no nearby races exist: 39 editions have no candidate in this GURS-only test; multiple KZTL races use different, secondary place references.
Twenty located edition keys represent only twelve unique settlement polygons; coverage is NOT twenty verified race start points.
The 2km radius-boundary band is a QA diagnostic, not the estimated positional error of any settlement reference.
Official GURS license CC BY 4.0 does NOT resolve dataset state/date attribution; no verified original dataset snapshot is recorded.
Existing referenced GURS features were independently compared to the stored 2026-11-12 location-candidates records; this check does not make a new live fetch nor verify data changes since that date.
Fixed nominal origin coordinates are testing examples and do not originate from user's precise GPS; user positions must not be persisted.
No Master/Registry/public records are modified by these offline tests.
